title.value: Effective Gesture-Based Framework for Capturing User Input
title.justification: The title encapsulates the main focus of the paper, which is developing a gesture-based framework for capturing user input.
title.quote: Effective Gesture Based Framework for Capturing User Input

extractions.description: The paper discusses a gesture-based framework using image processing and AI for virtual keyboards and mice, aiming to reduce peripheral costs and electronic waste.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper mentions the reduction of electronic waste and cost as benefits, these themes are not central to the main focus of the research, which is developing a gesture-based input system.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This system has a direct benefit of reducing peripheral cost, reducing electronics waste generated due to external devices and providing accessibility to people who cannot use the traditional keyboard and mouse.

primary_category.justification: The central theme of the paper is not directly related to climate or ecologically-related sustainable development but rather focuses on technological development in human-computer interaction.
primary_category.quote: In this research, we use the idea of image processing to create an application for seeing a computer keyboard using a novel framework which can detect hand gestures with precise accuracy while also being sustainable and financially viable.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper discusses the reduction of electronic waste, which falls under the category of Pollution as it relates to waste management and reduction.
secondary_categories.quote: The main motivation to build this Artificial keyboard is to reduce the electronic waste and to produce cost effective machines that still perform as efficiently as traditional systems.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not belong to any specific sub-category related to climate or ecologically-related sustainable development as per the provided list.
primary_sub_category.quote: Users of virtual keyboards can type on any surface as if it were a keyboard thanks to sensor technology and artificial intelligence.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Reduction of electronic waste through the development of virtual input devices addresses waste management concerns, fitting the sub-category of Waste under Pollution.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: This might usher in a new era of computer-human interaction where no direct physical contact is required, thus reducing peripheral cost, reducing electronics waste generated due to external devices.

applications.value: Reducing electronic waste by minimizing the use of physical keyboards and mice
applications.justification: The application addresses the environmental impact by focusing on reducing electronic waste through technological innovation.
applications.quote: The main motivation to build this Artificial keyboard is to reduce the electronic waste and to produce cost effective machines that still perform as efficiently as traditional systems.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories sufficiently cover any incidental sustainable development aspects mentioned in the paper.
new_primary_category.quote: The main idea behind this study is to develop input devices using gesture-based technology. Minimization of external hardware is cost friendly for the users and better for environment.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category is warranted as the aspects mentioned are covered under existing categories such as Pollution, specifically Waste management.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Minimization of external hardware is cost friendly for the users and better for environment.
